name: Alexandria
type: municipality of Romania; county seat in Romania
text: Alexandria (Romanian pronunciation: [alekˈsandri.a] ) is the capital city of the Teleorman County, Muntenia, Romania. It is located south-west of Bucharest, towards the Bulgarian border, and has over 40,000 inhabitants. The 44th parallel north passes just north of the city.

depictions.name: Alexandria
depictions.text: Alexandria is the thirteenth level of Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation. In it, Lara continues her quest for the Armour of Horus...
